appearance_facts.fact: The chart title is 'Renewable Energy Production by Source'.

There are five vertical bars, each with a percentage value printed above it.
The bars are arranged from left to right as: Solar, Wind, Hydroelectric, Biomass, Geothermal.
The Solar bar is yellow and its value is 41.2%.
The Wind bar is light blue and its value is 29.8%.
The Hydroelectric bar is blue and its value is 18.5%.
The Biomass bar is green and its value is 7.2%.
